card.name: Scattered words before a continuing clause
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words (of, due, in, and, very) and a space after a bracketed section reference, in both label and web text.

modes.label: Space after section references
modes.description: A blank space following a parenthetical list of label section numbers, just before the next section heading.

modes.label: Small words mid-sentence
modes.description: A linking word such as due, of, in or and where the sentence is still unfolding.
modes.example: WARNINGS Fatalities have occurred, although rarely,<< due>> to severe reactions to sulfonamides

card.plain: It fires on scattered small words in the middle of sentences, and I could not find a pattern that ties them together.
